question: Should this timeline issue remain a first-class core product surface, and should implementation be sequenced after the metadata-only audit ledger in https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/98521 or scoped as a separate ephemeral observer?
rationale: The source has enough signals for multiple plausible designs, but persistence owner, UI placement, retention, redaction, cross-session authorization, and export semantics need maintainer product/security intent.

options.title: Sequence after metadata audit
options.body: Use https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/98521 as the canonical durable ledger, then build the timeline command/view/export over that read contract.

options.title: Keep an ephemeral observer scope
options.body: Limit this issue to live Activity/TUI-style observation with no durable ledger or cross-session JSON export until the audit contract exists.

options.title: Close or narrow the request
options.body: Treat existing Activity plus trajectory export as enough for now and close or rewrite the issue to only track a smaller missing surface.

recommendation.title: Sequence after metadata audit
recommendation.body: Use https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/98521 as the canonical durable ledger, then build the timeline command/view/export over that read contract.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete owns the related metadata-audit direction and recent state-storage history that most affects the durable timeline boundary.
